title: 第5章 编织一个伟大的骗局第6章 我是你的主人
slug: 艾泽拉斯从掷骰子开始成神
lines: 滑倒的三人和女妖面面相觑。
斯黛拉转过头看向两个当场倒伏的援兵，表情仿佛在说，怎么了，这里很好睡吗？
女妖发出凄厉的尖叫，再次试图起身，却不小心踩到了自己的半透明裙摆，再次摔倒。
“你们谁会魔法？物理伤害貌似对它不起作用。”
艾伦说着，一边拖着斯黛拉的胳膊，一边艰难地往楼梯口爬。
“我会我会！”斯黛拉想举起手，但胳膊又被艾伦粗暴地拽下来。
“那你还等什么？快用魔法轰它啊！”
“可是你抓着我的手，我没法施法。”斯黛拉就躺在艾伦腿上，仰起头，委屈巴巴地望着他。
艾伦一时语塞，便松开了手。
就在这时，那女妖通过了豁免检定，重新漂浮起来。
情急之下，艾伦也硬生生站了起来，他要为斯黛拉释放法术创造时间。
好在，滑倒的女妖恼羞成怒，现在满腔的仇恨貌似都在艾伦身上。
所以它毫不犹豫地扑向和斯黛拉拉开距离的艾伦。
艾伦举着短剑，死死盯着女妖，他在赌。
女妖顷刻而至，朝他挥出枯瘦的鬼爪，艾伦举剑格挡。
叮当一声，短剑和鬼爪相撞，发出清脆的声响，艾伦眼睛一亮。
他就在赌这个，赌一个完全没有实体的鬼灵，说不定在发起进攻的时候会展现实体。
于是他当即松开了短剑，猛然下蹲，然后一个前冲抱住了女妖显形的身体。
“就是现在，向我开炮！”
斯黛拉也刚好念诵完毕咒语，举着双手，蓝紫色的奥术之光在她指尖闪耀。
炫目的光彩一闪而过，一个宛如异次元空间的圆圈显现。
紧接着，几袋清凉的泉水啪嗒啪嗒掉落在了斯黛拉的面前，堆成小山。
法雷扶额，艾伦再一次语塞。
这是……
造水术？！！
你认真的嘛！？？
看到这一幕，斯黛拉小脸一红，心虚地低下了脑袋，“那个，我只做过一段时间的法师学徒......”
眼看着怀中的女妖就要挣脱束缚，艾伦一咬牙，破罐子破摔，当即抱着女妖的裙子，顺势跪了下来，
“等一下，我想跟你聊一下！”
女妖本想直接撕烂这个不知轻重，没有分寸的臭男人的脸。
可当她低下头的一刻，看见在自己飘扬的裙摆包裹之下，仰着头望向她的那张脸。
他的头发有些乱，脸色还有些苍白，但那张脸……眉目清俊，轮廓分明，尤其是看着她一双眼睛，在昏暗光线下显得格外忧郁。
女妖放下骇人的鬼爪，狰狞的面庞逐渐变得柔和，愣愣望着艾伦，“你...说......”
“你是什么人，是谁把你变成这幅模样的？我来替你报仇！”
「游说检定：24点，成功」
「一个可怜的小女孩，被可怖的亡灵魔法，摧残成恐怖的厉鬼，好在你坚毅又英俊的面庞，让她想起了曾经爱慕过男孩，于是她决定听你说两句。」
“我...叫...米...米拉娜，我不知道是谁......把我变成...这样...”
见这样有戏，艾伦立马转变方向：“那你生前有什么愿望吗？别杀我们，我来替你实现遗愿！”
女妖呆愣愣地低头望着艾伦，
听到对方没有愿望，艾伦暗道不妙，好在女妖停顿了一会儿之后，又继续说了下去，“但是...我的小姐...蒂罗亚小姐...她有愿望......我想实现...她的愿望。”
艾伦松了口气，尽量让自己的目光更加柔和，坚毅，“告诉我，我一定帮助你、帮助你的蒂罗亚小姐，实现她的愿望！”

The three people who slipped and the banshee looked at each other.
Stella turned her head and looked at the two reinforcements who fell on the spot, her expression seemed to say, what's wrong, is it easy to sleep here?
ayy! ! ! ! ! !
The banshee let out a shrill scream and tried to get up again, but accidentally stepped on the hem of her translucent skirt and fell down again.
"Which of you knows magic? Physical damage seems to have no effect on it."
Allen said, dragging Stella's arm while climbing hard to the stairs.
"I will, I will!" Stella wanted to raise her hand, but her arm was roughly pulled down by Allen.
"Then what are you waiting for? Use magic to blast it!"
"But if you hold my hand, I can't cast the spell." Stella lay on Allen's lap, raised her head, and looked at him aggrievedly.
Allen was speechless for a moment, then let go of his hand.
Just then, the banshee passed her saving throw and floated back up.
In desperation, Allen also stood up abruptly. He wanted to create time for Stella to release the spell.
Fortunately, the slipped banshee became angry, and now all her hatred seems to be directed at Allen.
So it didn't hesitate to pounce on Allen who was keeping distance from Stella.
Allen raised his dagger and stared at the banshee, he was betting.
The banshee arrived in an instant and swung her skinny ghost claws at him. Allen raised his sword to block.
With a clang, the dagger and the ghost claw collided, making a crisp sound, and Allen's eyes lit up.
He was betting on this, betting on a completely incorporeal ghost spirit that might manifest itself when launching an attack.
So he immediately let go of the dagger, squatted down suddenly, and then rushed forward to hug the banshee's revealed body.
"Now, shoot me!"
Stella just finished reciting the spell, raised her hands, and the blue-purple arcane light shined on her fingertips.
A dazzling light flashed by, and a circle that looked like a different dimension appeared.
Immediately afterwards, several bags of cool spring water fell in front of Stella and piled up into a hill.
Farley held his forehead, and Allen was speechless again.
This is...
Water-generating technique? ! !
Are you serious! ? ?
Seeing this scene, Stella blushed and lowered her head guiltily, "Well, I only served as a mage apprentice for a period of time..."
Seeing that the banshee in his arms was about to break free, Allen gritted his teeth and broke the jar. He immediately hugged the banshee's skirt and knelt down.
"Wait a minute, I want to talk to you!"
The banshee wanted to tear the face of this stinky man who knew no importance or sense of proportion into pieces.
But when she lowered her head, she saw the face wrapped in her fluttering skirt, looking up at her.
His hair was a little messy and his face was a little pale, but that face... his features were handsome and clear-cut, especially her eyes, which looked particularly melancholy in the dim light.
The banshee put down her terrifying ghost claws, her ferocious face gradually softened, and she stared blankly at Allen, "You...said..."
"Who are you, and who turned you into this? I'm here to avenge you!"
"Persuasion check: 24 points, successful"
"A poor little girl was transformed into a terrifying ghost by the terrible undead magic. Fortunately, your resolute and handsome face reminded her of the boy she once loved, so she decided to listen to what you had to say."
"My... name is... Mi... Mirana, I don't know who... turned me into... like this..."
Seeing such a drama, Allen immediately changed his direction: "Then what did you wish for during your lifetime? Don't kill us, I will fulfill your last wish!"
The banshee looked down at Allen blankly,
"I...I have no...wishes..."
Hearing that the other party had no wish, Allen secretly thought something was wrong. Fortunately, the banshee paused for a while and then continued, "But...my lady...Miss Tiroya...she has a wish...I want to fulfill...her wish."
Allen breathed a sigh of relief and tried to make his eyes softer and firmer, "Tell me, I will help you and your Miss Tiroya to realize her wish!"
